counties.notes: Clark County, Nevada (Las Vegas metro, pop. 2.3M, county seat Las Vegas) contains roughly 73% of Nevada's total population. The AssessorMapv2/MapServer is the public parcel geometry layer published by the Clark County Geographic Information Systems Management Office (GISMO). 947,045 polygon parcels covering Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, Mesquite, and unincorporated Clark County. Verified 2026-05-11: APN LIKE '138%' wildcard query returns parcels. APN is an 11-digit Assessor Parcel Number with no internal punctuation in this layer (no dashes or spaces). Layer 1 of AssessorMapv2 is the parcel polygon layer; layer 0 is a label annotation layer. Owner name is NOT on this public REST layer. For owner-name lookups, use the Clark County Assessor's web portal at maps.clarkcountynv.gov/assessor/AssessorParcelDetail/ownr.aspx (search by owner name) or the Real Property Records Search at clarkcountynv.gov/government/assessor/property_search/real-property-records; both are free browser tools. Bulk ownership data from the Assessor requires a paid subscription. GISMO open-data hub: clarkcountygis-ccgismo.hub.arcgis.com.

71 fields confirmed including OBJECTID, APN, REGION, PIN, RECMAP, BOOK, PAGE, BLOCK, PARCEL, SUBNAME, TOWNSHIP, RANGE, SECTION_, FLOOR, MAPLINK, FLR, Shape, Shape.STArea(), STREETNUM, STREETDIR, STREET, CITY, SITUSZIP, FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, MAILING1, MAILING2, MAILCITY, MAILSTATE, MAILZIP, LAND_USE, Zoning, WATER, SEWER, ACREAGE, TAXDIST, BEDROOMS, BATHS, YEARBLT, LANDASS, BUILDASS, TOTALASS, LANDAPR, BUILDAPR, TOTALAPR, DEPRECIATION, SALEDATE, SALEPRICE, OCCUPANCY, PROPCODE, TAXYEAR, STORIES, TOWNHOUSE, SQFEET, UNITS, AVCONSYEAR, BUILDINGTYPE, NBHD, SPECPROPCODE, QC, LAND_BASE, NBC, Fireplaces, HeatType, SecHeatType, Agency, AG_ABBR, FullAddress, ZoningWithDetail, Zoning_GIS, STRAP. Owner name available as FIRSTNAME + LASTNAME (split fields). 2026-10-03: LASTNAME is now declared before FIRSTNAME, because the site's owner-field classifier and the stdio MCP server both search the FIRST owner-matching field, so a surname search was running against first names (FIRSTNAME holds values like EDWARD M III; LASTNAME holds SMITH). The sampleQuery already searched LASTNAME and still returns rows. Live query confirmed: APN 134087 returns 'MIEKO E SPAHR' in RENO 89503. maxRecordCount=1000. Covers Reno, Sparks, and unincorporated Washoe County (pop. 480,000). Note: owner name is public per Nevada law (unlike Clark County which also has a public layer but no owner). Current version 11.4.

counties.notes: Lyon County, Nevada (FIPS 32019; Yerington, Fernley, Dayton, Silver Springs) publishes the Assessor's parcels on its own ArcGIS Server as Landbase/Land_Use_Parcel, MapServer layer 10 'Land Use -- Parcel': 35,343 parcels on 2026-10-08, maxRecordCount 2000, resultRecordCount accepted, answers any Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to the caller. 35,159 rows (99.5%) carry an owner and 33,164 a physical address. The owner is PANAME (alias 'Assessed Owner', 'LAST, FIRST' for individuals, for example DOE, JANE & JOHN); the situs is PHY_ADDR (123 EXAMPLE RD, blank on some vacant land); the owner mailing address is PMADD1 and PMADD2 plus PMCTST ('YERINGTON, NV') and PZIP; the parcel number is APN (003-034-01, dashed). The layer carries a great deal else (values, acreage, land-use and exemption codes, deed data, an owner email column PEMADR that we do not index). SLOW OWNER SEARCH: the layer has no index on PANAME. Measured 2026-10-08: UPPER(PANAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' (what the free Owner Lookup and Parcel Lookup tools send) took 13 to 15 s and returned 347 rows, an anchored UPPER(PANAME) LIKE 'SMITH%' took 4.5 s and returned 309, APN equality and a PHY_ADDR prefix about 1 s, and a count over PHY_ADDR about 9 s. The tools set no client timeout, so a wildcard owner search normally completes but slowly; the sampleQuery uses the anchored form. Use LAST-name-first prefix terms for speed. Do NOT use Landbase/Parcels/MapServer/1 (about 43 s per query), and do not use the statewide Nevada water layer: its service description forbids sharing under NRS 250. The service's Python urllib default User-Agent is refused with HTTP 403 (any other User-Agent, or none, is served), so a script probing it from Python must send its own. License: the item's licenseInfo reads 'Accessible by the public.' and its accessInformation is 'Lyon County, NV Assessor's office'; no formal terms page was found, so licenseUrl is the county GIS site root.
